interface: async def verify(config: dict[str, str]) -> dict[str, object]

read_scope.budget: 一个共享预算含auth+business：总7、每route1；禁止redirect/alternate origin/托管fallback/其它页或设备/媒体URL请求。budget rejection必须记失败，不把实际次数夹成上限。
read_scope.normal_success_target: 从本次第一普通设备首页选择一个非空serial，内存原值绑定，其余五步重复该值；不从历史回执猜目标、不输出或hash标识。
read_scope.invalid_token_behavior: 生产SDK仍按其读策略处理；本验收guard不授权第二次同route网络请求，重复auth/业务会在delegate前拒绝，该次case失败，不静默扩大7次边界。
read_scope.no_target: 仅一页；空/缺ID不自动分页/改managed接口/猜第一个其它设备。

report_fields.logical_calls: completed terminal SDK business call events: int 0..6, count observed even on failure, no clamping
report_fields.attempted_routes: ordered list of admitted fixed route labels only: auth/list/info/channels/status/capabilities/version, no duplicates
report_fields.successful_steps: actual succeeded facade terminals, fixed labels only: list/info/channels/status/capabilities/version
report_fields.diagnostics_intact: bool; require passed diagnostic checks for full success
report_fields.closed: bool from actual completion of AsyncClient.aclose()
report_fields.boundary_rejected: bool from any rejected outgoing request

implementation: Repository verifier only. Reuse AsyncClient, inspect_device_async, DiagnosticRecorder and existing synchronous verifier pure input/origin/form/route/budget rules. Extract only the existing field predicate into a shared function in verify_diagnostics.py; retain old synchronous interface and outcomes. Use genuine AsyncBaseTransport with async delegate, no sync-to-thread wrapper. Intercept before delegate; enforce fixed origin, exact raw route, exact POST form field set/values/one copy, canonical form content type, one per route, shared 7-call budget, fixed order, no redirection/proxies or transport retries.

Use real first page page_start=0/page_size=1. A missing/empty first serial or empty list returns not_verified. No broader discovery. Invalid payload/permission/timeouts/close failures/route rejection return failed. One guard order/accepted list shared across auth and business. Refuse forwarded custom auth headers or query credentials. Logical action count and route count come from observed calls, never a predicted value.

verify obtains a fresh recorder and budget per call. After closure verify real ordered outcomes, mode=async and region=domestic, six successes plus inspect_device_async inspection and client.aclose close spans, recorder zero errors/drops, exactly seven admitted distinct routes, zero rejection. An incomplete/compromised report never yields passed. Preserve cancellation on verify; close on exception/cancellation. Handle data and credentials only within this process. Return the finite projection listed, never the raw diagnostic report, response, identifiers or free-form errors.

For live use only via explicit interactive local --prompt. No CLI secrets, browser server, real data fixtures, env auto-discovery, file input, SDK global changes, or background service. Require interactive TTY; hidden getpass for BOTH inputs under warnings.filterwarnings(error, category=GetPassWarning), abort before networking on fallback/empty/missing and do not echo. Overall network run under asyncio.timeout(90), HTTP timeout 10; read-only. No external upload. Optional --output opens exclusively before networking, refuses pre-existing files/symlinks; use mode 0600, no automatic file for ordinary usage; clean empty/partial on failure. Emit only the allowlisted report, fatal preflight prints fixed safe message and nonzero. Cancellation/interrupt never becomes passed.

Tests use AsyncClient real request path, mock only HTTP transport; require correct six async calls and success projection, empty target and explicit business errors, no cross-device or extra fields/duplicate token, forbidden origins/route/query, repeated route/refresh blocked before delegate, cancellation closure, output exclusivity and no low-level secret echo. No independently authored browser form. Output and recorded git source pins must be checked before updating real outcome.
authorized: Domestic ordinary-device read-only scope carried from existing authorization. No device writes; account credentials entered only at user terminal. Real success requires a fresh matched receipt and offline checks on current implementation.
